Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

issue.title: sites.fastspring.com: regression of #55938, mandatory "Terms of Service" checkbox hidden by generic `.gdpr-container` rule, checkout can't be completed

labels.name: A: In progress
labels.description: Work on the issue is in progress

issue.body:
### Prerequisites - [x] This site DOES NOT contain sexually explicit material - [x] Filters were updated before reproducing an issue - [x] AdGuard product version is up-to-date - [x] Browser version is up-to-date - [x] Disabling AdGuard protection (allowlisting the site) resolves the issue **Product:** AdGuard for Mac **AdGuard version:** 2.20 **Problem type:** Website or app doesn't work properly **Browser:** Firefox 158 (Desktop) **URL:** https://sites.fastspring.com/hopperapp/order/confirm **Enabled filters:** - Ad Blocking: AdGuard Base filter - Privacy: AdGuard Tracking Protection filter - Annoyances: AdGuard Annoyances filter (v2.2.83.64, filters updated right before reporting), AdGuard Popups filter, AdGuard Other Annoyances filter, Adblock Warning Removal List, Fanboy's Annoyances - Language-specific: AdGuard Chinese, Dutch, French, German, Japanese, Russian, Spanish/Portuguese, Turkish, Ukrainian filters; AdBlockID; Dandelion Sprout's Nordic Filters; EasyList Czech and Slovak; EasyList Italy; Official Polish filters for AdBlock, uBlock Origin & AdGuard **Stealth Mode:** none (Stealth Mode disabled) ### Comment 1. On FastSpring's classic store order-confirmation page (reached after PayPal/card approval, before the charge), the legally required consent block "FastSpring Terms of Service and Privacy Policy / [ ] I agree with the terms of service and privacy policy" is hidden. Without ticking it, "Complete Order" cannot proceed, so the purchase cannot be completed. Allowlisting the site fixes it. The block is wrapped in: ```html
... I agree with the terms of service and privacy policy ... ``` It is matched by this generic rule in AdGuard Annoyances filter: ``` ##.gdpr-container:not(#style_important) ``` No other enabled rule matches any element around the checkbox. This is a regression of #55938 (see also #81519). The filter still contains the exception added for it: ``` sites.fastspring.com#@#.gdpr-container ``` But the generic rule is now `##.gdpr-container:not(#style_important)`. Element-hiding exceptions only cancel a rule with the identical selector, so the old exception no longer applies. Suggested fix (matching the current selector): ``` sites.fastspring.com#@#.gdpr-container:not(#style_important) ``` (FastSpring hosts checkouts for many vendors on sites.fastspring.com, so this likely affects many stores.) Note on reproduction: this page is only reachable after entering payment details, so screenshots and the DOM excerpt above were taken from a real checkout. Screenshot 2 was produced by injecting the exact rule's CSS into the same page. 2. Screenshots: two full-page screenshots (consent block visible with the site allowlisted, and missing with the rule applied.)

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

# Sorry. The website is infected by AdShield, Inc.

Unfortunately, It is complicated to resolve with a regular adblock rule because the website is being protected by service of Ad-Shield that is an anti-adblock company.

## Userscript Installation
Please block Ad-Shield advertisement by installing [tinyShield userscript](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield).
Please check its installation guideline written in English by visiting [this URL](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.md).

If you can understand Korean language, please refer https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/blob/main/README.ko.md.

New change of tinyShield's build script for Apple Safari Extension user (made at 2026 Apr 21) is available.

## Still Have a Problem?
An issue is occurred when the userscript is applied, please report to [this issue tracker](https://github.com/FilteringDev/tinyShield/issues).

### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking) [https://fastcover.com.au/faq](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Ffastcover.com.au%2Ffaq) ### Comment > Hey there! > > Ben from Help Scout's Support Team here. > > d3hb14vkzrxvla.cloudfront.net is listed as Phishing in AdGuard’s database (https://reports.adguard.com/en/d3hb14vkzrxvla.cloudfront.net/report.html, last updated 2026-10-21 02:04). This is a false positive. > > The host is a CloudFront distribution owned by Help Scout (helpscout.com). It serves JSON configuration for Help Scout’s Beacon support widget (e.g. /v1/<beacon-id>) to thousands of customer websites. It hosts no pages, forms, or login flows. Google Safe Browsing and Yandex do not list it. > > The listing applies across AdGuard products, not just the one selected above. The product details are from one affected end user’s environment (AdGuard for Windows on Windows 10), but with the URL on AdGuard's blacklist, potentially every AdGuard user visiting a site with Beacon embedded sees the warning. Please remove the domain from the Phishing category. > > Please send any questions to `help@helpscout.com` ### Screenshots

issue.body:
# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).
> Recently, YouTube anti-adblock script added infinite dummy advertisements to try to neutralize the userscript. ( [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing#264](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing/issues/264) )

> [!WARNING]
> Please check that there no another web browser extension that has adblocking feature is enabled on your web browser. It can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.
> In this case, please re-enable AdGuard's filtering by toggling the protection toggle.
> Following the instructions can be needed.

### The instructions
1. Force to update the filters by clicking the reload button in AdGuard Browser Extension/AdGuard mobile or update tray menu in your system tray. [^2]
2. Reload the YouTube webpage without cache by pressing <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd> [^3].
3. Clear cache, cookies and site data of your web browser.
4. Re-open your web browser completely (checking your system monitor[^4] will be better).

[^1]: https://gitlab.com/adblockinc/ext/adblockplus/adblockplusui/-/issues/1576
[^2]: [AdGuard for Windows](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-windows/overview/#tray-menu); [AdGuard for Mac](https://adguard.com/kb/adguard-for-mac/overview/#updates-check); 
[^3]: On macOS, <kbd>Command</kbd> + <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>R</kbd>
[^4]: Task Manager on Windows, System Monitor on GNOME Shell, KDE System Guard on KDE Plasma or Activity Monitor on macOS. 


Previous issue https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/issues/198973

It serves JSON configuration for Help Scout’s Beacon support widget (e.g. /v1/<beacon-id>) to thousands of customer websites. It hosts no pages, forms, or login flows. This issue has been automatically marked as stale because it has been open for 3 days with no activity.
Unfortunately, our resources are limited and we can not always take the time to respond to requests about websites that are not popular enough. The issue will be closed if no further activity occurs.

# ATTENTION

> [!NOTE]  
> YouTube changes their detection scripts regularly. That means that sometime you can face the detection message.
> If all the following instructions do not work, please **email filters@adguard.com** or wait until any update is available. 

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use another adblocker in the same time because using another adblocker can delay/lags the YouTube loading (e.g., AdBlock Plus and AdBlock)[^1] OR interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

> [!CAUTION] 
> Please do not use an userscript related to the bypassing YouTube detection message like [TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing](https://github.com/TheRealJoelmatic/RemoveAdblockThing).

> [!IMPORTANT]  
> Saving memory feature of your web browser or sleep feature of your operating system can interfere AdGuard's filtering functionality.

comment.body:
Following up on @milkeyway0's suggestion: I traced this on a Japanese account today (2026-10-22, LINE for iOS), and `da.flvcdn.net` is the one that matters. `dm.slim01.jp` is not needed.

**Setup.** The handset ran AdGuard Home as its DNS resolver, and for the test it was routed through a WireGuard tunnel to the same box. That let me read the TLS SNI and the byte count of every connection the app opened, so I could see connections that never showed up as DNS queries.

**Findings**

- On launch, the chat list banner (McDonald's at the time of capture) came with a connection to `da.flvcdn.net` that downloaded about 307 KB three seconds after the app opened. No other new connection carried ad-sized data. The rest were the messaging gateway (`legy-jp.line-apps.com`) and regular `line-scdn.net` image hosts.
- Blocking `||da.flvcdn.net^` alone removed the chat list banner, both over the tunnel and later on plain home Wi-Fi.
- Blocking `||dm.slim01.jp^` alone did not remove it. In one capture where the banner was displayed, the app never connected to `dm.slim01.jp` at all.
- `da.flvcdn.net` → `da-flvcdn-net.fcdn.flava-cloud.com` → `da-flvcdn-net.flava.akadns.net` → `d12pj4j0wr5qtx.cloudfront.net`. Over about seven weeks of logs from two iPhones, 158 of 160 queries for it fired within 10 seconds of LINE's own hosts. No other app was active around the remaining two.

**Why it can look like "cached ads".** In the same second `da.flvcdn.net` first resolved to `0.0.0.0`, the phone still tried its previous real address over QUIC (UDP 443). In the tunnel I was rejecting UDP 443, so that attempt failed and the banner disappeared. On plain Wi-Fi the QUIC attempt goes straight through, so the banner survives the first launch after the rule is added. Force-quitting LINE and toggling Wi-Fi made the block take effect. That may also explain some "still seeing ads" reports above.

**Not reachable by DNS** (for anyone chasing these):

- The banner in the Home tab
- The text line above Notes and Albums. Its image is already blocked through `ad.line-scdn.net`, but the text still appears.

In both cases, the only LINE connections carrying data were `legy-jp.line-apps.com` and the image hosts behind a CloudFront distribution that about 30 `line-scdn.net` names share. Blocking either breaks the app.

**Caveat.** All of this comes from one household and two iPhones. `flvcdn.net` belongs to LY Corporation, and `tag.flvcdn.net` is already in the tracking filter. I have not checked whether other LY apps, such as Yahoo! JAPAN, use `da.flvcdn.net` for something other than ads. Someone with those apps installed should check before this goes into a widely used list.
